note: 单元通关专属迷你阅读(健康生活主题,独立短文,不在阅读关出现)。短文2-3句+2题,答案转述非照抄,2题覆盖不同位置。

finalReading.passage: Leo used to skip breakfast every day to save a little time, and by mid-morning he often felt dizzy and weak. After a talk with the school nurse, he made up his mind to eat a simple, healthy breakfast each morning. Within two weeks he had more energy in class and stopped feeling tired, and he was proud that one tiny change had made such a big difference.

questions.q: Why did Leo often feel dizzy before?
options: Because he went without breakfast to save time.
Because he ate too much in the morning.
questions.explanation: 原文 'skip breakfast every day to save a little time… felt dizzy and weak' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did Leo feel after the change?
options: Proud that a small change had helped a lot.
Sorry that he had started eating breakfast.
questions.explanation: 末句 'proud that one tiny change had made such a big difference'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。
